gameLaunch.executableDescription: LunaBox uses this executable to launch the game. This is the executable path you selected initially
gameLaunch.processNameDescription:
Specify the actual game process name (including .exe suffix).
If not specified, LunaBox will try to monitor the executable path. If your previous selection was a launcher, you will need to manually specify this process in the selection box that appears after game startup.
Pre-filling here avoids manual selection every time you launch.

gameSettings.recordActiveTimeOnlyDescription: When enabled, play time will only be recorded when the game window is in foreground focus. This provides more accurate statistics of actual play time, excluding afk and background running time.
gameSettings.activeTimeNote1: Enabling this option will record incomplete running time of the game process (excluding background time)
gameSettings.activeTimeNote2: Existing play records will not be affected by this setting
gameSettings.activeTimeNote3: Some fullscreen games may affect the accuracy of focus detection
gameSettings.autoProcessDetectionDescription:
When enabled, LunaBox will automatically prompt you to select the actual game process when the launcher process exits quickly.
When disabled, it will directly use the saved process name or executable handle for monitoring, suitable for single-exe games or scenarios that don't require complex detection.
